user.title: Connect to your ChargePoint charger
user.description: Enter the local IP and the 64-character API token from the charger's advanced settings page. The local REST API must be enabled.

authorize_charge_session.description: (De)authorize a charge session on the charger using a token from the local list.

config_entry_id.description: Advanced - target a config entry by its ID instead of by device.
